result_text:
The contributor tables and the recent-commits bar chart no longer stop at `contributorsListLimit`. The reports module compiles and its tests pass offline.

Two files changed in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/`:

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`**: removed the `.limit(limit)` on the table stream, the `limit` variable, and the "The list is limited to N items" note. This covers `contributors.html`, `contributors-recent.html`, and the bots and teams pages, which share this class. Sort order is unchanged.
- **`ContributorListsSection.java`**: removed the `.limit(...)` in `getBarsHtml`, so the bar chart draws one bar per recently active contributor.

`contributorsListLimit` still exists in `LandscapeConfiguration` and is no longer read by these two code paths. I didn't check whether any other code reads it. Nothing is committed.
